name: JPY Futures OI Squeeze Flip → USD/JPY Event Study (Rate Differential Regime Split)
description: Research event study analyzing USD/JPY performance in the 30 days following a JPY futures open interest "squeeze flip" event, split by US-Japan 2-year rate differential regime. Uses J6 (CME JPY futures) open interest with futures_continuation for stable OI series. Event detection: (1) 252-day rolling Z-score of OI, (2) extreme low OI flag at Z < -2.0, (3) squeeze flip when Z-score crosses above zero AND was in extreme low state within prior 60 trading days. Regime classification: US 2yr yield (FRED DGS2) minus Japan govt bond yield (FRED INTGSBJPM193N, monthly ffilled to daily); 20-day change in rate differential classifies each event as "Widening Carry" (diff increasing, USD favored) or "Narrowing Carry" (diff decreasing, JPY favored). Outputs: summary table split by regime, grouped bar chart of avg returns by regime and horizon, side-by-side histograms of 30d returns by regime, OI Z-score area chart with event overlay, and event markers with regime labels and rate differential data.
source:
# =============================================================================
# JPY FUTURES OI SQUEEZE FLIP → USD/JPY EVENT STUDY
# WITH US-JAPAN 2-YEAR RATE DIFFERENTIAL REGIME SPLIT
# =============================================================================
# Event: JPY futures OI Z-score crosses above 0 after being deeply depressed (<-2)
# within the prior ~12 weeks (60 trading days)
# Regime: 20-day change in US-Japan 2yr rate differential at event time
#   - Widening = diff increasing (carry favors USD)
#   - Narrowing = diff decreasing (carry favors JPY — hypothesis: stronger signal)
# Reaction: USD/JPY forward returns at 5d, 10d, 20d, 30d
# OI source: J6 (CME Japanese Yen futures) via reference_futures + futures_continuation
# Rate data: US 2yr = FRED DGS2 (daily), Japan govt bond = FRED INTGSBJPM193N (monthly, ffilled)
# =============================================================================

# --- USD/JPY Price Data (primary asset) ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
idx = index()

# --- JPY Futures OI Data (J6 = CME JPY futures) ---
j6_ref = reference_futures(ticker="J6")()
j6_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(j6_ref.o, j6_ref.h, j6_ref.l, j6_ref.c, j6_ref.v, j6_ref.oi, j6_ref.s)

# Forward-fill OI to handle weekends/holidays (FX trades when futures don't)
oi_raw = ffill(j6_cont.oi)

# =============================================================================
# RATE DIFFERENTIAL: US 2yr minus Japan Govt Bond Yield
# =============================================================================

# US 2-year Treasury yield (daily, FRED DGS2)
us_2y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="DGS2", use_alfred=False)()
us_2y = ffill(us_2y_raw.result)

# Japan government bond yield (monthly, FRED INTGSBJPM193N, ffilled to daily)
jp_gy_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="INTGSBJPM193N", use_alfred=False)()
jp_gy = ffill(jp_gy_raw.result)

# Rate differential = US 2yr - Japan govt bond yield (in percentage points)
rate_diff = us_2y - jp_gy

# 20-day change in rate differential (positive = widening, negative = narrowing)
rate_diff_20d_chg = rate_diff - (rate_diff >> 20)

# =============================================================================
# OI Z-SCORE (252-day rolling window = ~1 year)
# =============================================================================

oi_zscore = zscore(window=252)(oi_raw)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT DETECTION: SQUEEZE FLIP
# =============================================================================

# Step 1: Flag extreme low OI state (Z < -2.0)
is_extreme_low = oi_zscore < -2.0

# Step 2: How many bars since last extreme low?
bars_since_extreme = coalesce(barssince()(is_extreme_low), 9999)

# Step 3: Was extreme low within prior 60 trading days (~12 weeks)?
was_extreme_recent = bars_since_extreme <= 60

# Step 4: OI Z-score crosses above zero
z_cross_above_zero = crossover(oi_zscore, 0.0)

# Step 5: Squeeze flip = zero crossing AND recent extreme low
is_squeeze_flip = z_cross_above_zero and was_extreme_recent

# =============================================================================
# REGIME CLASSIFICATION AT EVENT TIME
# =============================================================================

# Widening = rate differential increased over last 20 days (favors USD)
# Narrowing = rate differential decreased over last 20 days (favors JPY)
is_widening = is_squeeze_flip and (rate_diff_20d_chg > 0)
is_narrowing = is_squeeze_flip and (rate_diff_20d_chg <= 0)

# Event counters per regime
event_count_widening = 1.0 if is_widening else 0.0
event_count_narrowing = 1.0 if is_narrowing else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# FORWARD RETURNS (USD/JPY % change post-event)
# =============================================================================

post_5d = ((close << 5) - close) / close
post_10d = ((close << 10) - close) / close
post_20d = ((close << 20) - close) / close
post_30d = ((close << 30) - close) / close

# Approximate max gain / max loss within 30d window
# Use max/min of the 4 horizons as a proxy
max_gain_proxy = post_5d if (post_5d >= post_10d) and (post_5d >= post_20d) and (post_5d >= post_30d) else (post_10d if (post_10d >= post_20d) and (post_10d >= post_30d) else (post_20d if post_20d >= post_30d else post_30d))
max_loss_proxy = post_5d if (post_5d <= post_10d) and (post_5d <= post_20d) and (post_5d <= post_30d) else (post_10d if (post_10d <= post_20d) and (post_10d <= post_30d) else (post_20d if post_20d <= post_30d else post_30d))

# =============================================================================
# EVENT-FILTERED SERIES BY REGIME
# =============================================================================

# --- Widening regime event-filtered series ---
w_post5 = where(is_widening, post_5d)
w_post10 = where(is_widening, post_10d)
w_post20 = where(is_widening, post_20d)
w_post30 = where(is_widening, post_30d)
w_jpy_str = where(is_widening, 1.0 if post_30d < 0 else 0.0)
w_max_gain = where(is_widening, max_gain_proxy)
w_max_loss = where(is_widening, max_loss_proxy)

# --- Narrowing regime event-filtered series ---
n_post5 = where(is_narrowing, post_5d)
n_post10 = where(is_narrowing, post_10d)
n_post20 = where(is_narrowing, post_20d)
n_post30 = where(is_narrowing, post_30d)
n_jpy_str = where(is_narrowing, 1.0 if post_30d < 0 else 0.0)
n_max_gain = where(is_narrowing, max_gain_proxy)
n_max_loss = where(is_narrowing, max_loss_proxy)

# --- Histogram: 30d return distributions by regime ---
hist_widening = where(is_widening, post_30d)
hist_narrowing = where(is_narrowing, post_30d)

# OI Z-score area chart: split into positive/negative for area fill
z_positive = where(oi_zscore >= 0, oi_zscore)
z_negative = where(oi_zscore < 0, oi_zscore)

# Event marker helpers
ev_zscore = where(is_squeeze_flip, oi_zscore)
ev_oi = where(is_squeeze_flip, oi_raw)
ev_rate_diff = where(is_squeeze_flip, rate_diff)
ev_rate_diff_chg = where(is_squeeze_flip, rate_diff_20d_chg)
ev_regime_label = where(is_squeeze_flip, 1.0 if rate_diff_20d_chg > 0 else 0.0)
ev_post5 = where(is_squeeze_flip, post_5d)
ev_post10 = where(is_squeeze_flip, post_10d)
ev_post30 = where(is_squeeze_flip, post_30d)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- 1. Summary Table: Split by Regime ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='OI Squeeze Flip by Rate Differential Regime',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=['Widening Carry (USD Favored)', 'Narrowing Carry (JPY Favored)'],
        col_headers=['Events', 'Median +30d', '% JPY Strengthened', 'Avg Max Gain', 'Avg Max Loss'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Emerald),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Red),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Emerald),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Red)
        ]
    ),
    category='OI Squeeze Flip',
    order=0
)(event_count_widening, w_post30, w_jpy_str, w_max_gain, w_max_loss, event_count_narrowing, n_post30, n_jpy_str, n_max_gain, n_max_loss)

# --- 2. Grouped Bar Chart: Avg USD/JPY Return by Regime and Horizon ---
# Stack = regime (x-axis categories), Name = horizon (legend / grouped bars)
# Blue = Widening regime, Indigo = Narrowing regime
xy_bars(
    title='Avg USD/JPY Return After Squeeze Flip by Regime',
    category='OI Squeeze Flip',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg Post-Event Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5d', color=Color.Sky, stack='Widening Carry'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+10d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Widening Carry'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+20d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Widening Carry'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+30d', color=Color.Indigo, stack='Widening Carry'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5d', color=Color.Sky, stack='Narrowing Carry'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+10d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Narrowing Carry'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+20d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Narrowing Carry'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+30d', color=Color.Indigo, stack='Narrowing Carry')
    ]),
    order=1
)(w_post5, w_post10, w_post20, w_post30, n_post5, n_post10, n_post20, n_post30)

# --- 3a. Histogram: 30d Returns — Widening Carry Regime ---
histogram(
    title='30d USD/JPY Returns: Widening Carry (USD Favored)',
    category='OI Squeeze Flip',
    bins=12,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    x_axis_label='30d USD/JPY Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    show_analytics=True,
    order=2
)(value=hist_widening)

# --- 3b. Histogram: 30d Returns — Narrowing Carry Regime ---
histogram(
    title='30d USD/JPY Returns: Narrowing Carry (JPY Favored)',
    category='OI Squeeze Flip',
    bins=12,
    fill_color=Color.Indigo,
    x_axis_label='30d USD/JPY Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    show_analytics=True,
    order=3
)(value=hist_narrowing)

# --- 4. Line Chart: OI Z-Score Over Time With Event Overlay ---
xy_lines(
    title='JPY Futures OI Z-Score (252d Rolling)',
    category='OI Squeeze Flip',
    y_axis_label='OI Z-Score',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    area=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Above Zero', color=Color.Gray),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Below Zero', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, title='Extreme Low (-2σ)', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=4
)(idx, z_positive, z_negative)

# --- 5. Event Markers on USD/JPY Chart ---
# Includes regime label (1=Widening, 0=Narrowing), rate diff level, and 20d change
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='OI Squeeze Flip',
        icon=Icon.ZapIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='OI Z-Score', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Open Interest', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Regime (1=Widen 0=Narrow)', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Rate Differential (pp)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='20d Diff Change (pp)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+5d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+10d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+30d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_squeeze_flip, ev_zscore, ev_oi, ev_regime_label, ev_rate_diff, ev_rate_diff_chg, ev_post5, ev_post10, ev_post30)
